svg.text: The Pi's alarm clock: one deploy round
Concept 8 · the systemd security guard (Module 12) woken by an alarm clock · scripts/deploy.sh, part gateway (the main-path Pi)
smarthome-update.timer = the alarm clock
[Timer]
OnBootSec=5min
OnUnitActiveSec=15min
RandomizedDelaySec=60
Unit=smarthome-update.service
5 minutes after the Pi starts, then 15 minutes after the
previous round STARTED (also when it failed), + a random
0–60 seconds: many Pis don't ask at the same second
a new release is deployed at most ±17 minutes after the tag, + the pull
smarthome-update.service = a security guard that runs once
[Service]
Type=oneshot
User=budi
WorkingDirectory=/home/budi/mini-smart-home
Environment=DEPLOY_PARTS=gateway
ExecStart=/bin/sh /home/budi/mini-smart-home/scripts/deploy.sh
TimeoutStartSec=15min
oneshot = a guard that runs once, then sits down again · budi = an
ordinary user in the docker group, not root · through sh: the repo file
needs no chmod +x · free path: Environment="DEPLOY_PARTS=center gateway"
wake up
One round of scripts/deploy.sh on the Pi (part gateway)
right: what is written to the journal (exact text of the script, no time stamp; … = shortened)
not root?
run as budi, not with sudo
FAIL: don't run this with sudo or as root: …
the repo copy on main, without edited files?
changes always go through a pull request, not on the Pi
FAIL: files were edited directly on this machine …
a public repo: no account
FAIL: can't fetch tags from GitHub: …
the latest release tag on main
--sort=-v:refname; tags on other branches are ignored
v2.0.1 already deployed (gateway): no new release
= the same as the record: done, Docker not touched
no tag yet: no release (tag v<version>) on GitHub yet: …
only straight forward; then the package.json version = the tag?
FAIL: main on this machine can't fast-forward to v2.0.1: …
another version: FAIL: the repo copy on this machine holds version …
folder edge: docker compose pull --quiet
the official Mosquitto image with an exact tag
FAIL: the gateway image can't be pulled yet … The old containers keep running.
--no-build: the Pi never builds an image
FAIL: the gateway failed to start: …
gateway.conf or acl-broker changed?
yes: docker compose restart mosquitto, once per release;
restart, not HUP: the store-and-forward queue stays
gateway broker configuration changed: restart mosquitto
wait 15 seconds: is anything Restarting?
a broker that keeps crashing is caught here
FAIL: the gateway broker keeps crashing (Restarting): …
record the deployed release
.git/smarthome-deployed = v2.0.1 gateway
v2.0.0 -> v2.0.1 deployed (gateway)
FAIL at any step
exit code 1 and the record isn't updated: the next round (15 minutes
later) tries again. Never down -v, prune, or git reset --hard.
A release that brings a new deploy.sh: the script runs again once with its new content
The center part (VPS, free-path Pi)
pull → up --no-build --wait → restart mosquitto/grafana when
their configuration changed → scripts/smoke-test.sh: image = version,
/health names the version and "database":true, the dashboard through Caddy
Reading the result on the Pi
systemctl list-timers smarthome-update.timer
journalctl -u smarthome-update.service -n 30
Honest limits
a broker that only crashes after ±10 seconds can slip past step 9 (a monitor
that keeps watching = Module 30). The Indonesian edition's lab: a simulated
gateway, 4 releases, 2.0.0 by hand, 2.0.1, 2.0.2, 2.0.4 woken by a simulated
scheduler every ±1 minute, not systemd; the units only checked with
systemd-analyze verify (systemd 259). This edition: ExecStart run by hand
